tagline: Tum reply karte rahe, woh 'dekhti hoon' karti rahi

acts.title: Meet-cute
acts.text: Pehle 8 hafte: 2 AM rallies of 40+ messages, and you said ❤️ first in week 6 ...

acts.title: Interval twist
acts.text: Week 9 changed the background score: their replies went from minutes to hours ...

acts.title: Now showing
acts.text: You still start 7 of 10 chats. They turn toward 61% of your bids ...

milestone_notes.caption: Week 9: replies went from minutes to hours

verdict: Strong opening, slow second half. Let them write the next scene.
advice: Let them start the next few conversations.
Ask one follow-up question about something they said.
